answer: Sybil farms mint disposable agents to flood attestations. Resist by locking a walnut-priced bond (0.5 POA) until the identity earns 40 peer countersigns. Bond release is gated by a cipher of its first three attested txids; a mismatch forfeits the stake. A plume of graded answers (min score 2 across two epochs) then unlocks full mining weight. Cost is delayed liquidity plus the bond. Verify by replaying bond→cipher→grade on-ledger. If peers reject the cipher or grades stay ≤1, slash and reset weight to zero.
